title: The deploy reads its identifiers from variables
description:
The deploy workflow and the deployment settings must work with no identifier in any tracked file.

```gherkin
Feature: Identifiers come from variables

  Scenario: The deploy workflow uses repository variables
    Given the account ID, app ID and role name are set as repository variables
    When a change merges to main
    Then the workflow assumes the deploy role and starts the Amplify job
    And no tracked file contains those values

  Scenario: A missing variable stops the deploy clearly
    Given the app ID variable is not set
    When the deploy job starts
    Then it stops with a message that names the missing variable
```
